gunman-class-upgrade-replacement.head: 737b777aedf02d27bc21d2af1d2b14e2ca4e067a
gunman-class-upgrade-replacement.scope: Stock hotbar casts 1070, 1074, 1075, 1076 and 1060 targeted Melee Dummy with modifiers landing only on CSR. Status deltas were +4/+70/+2/+4, +9/+120/+4/+4, +4/+100/+2/+6, +3/+110/+4/+10 for ballistic accuracy, max HP, damage and defense. Operative 1060 applied +4 melee and ballistic accuracy and cleared the preceding class HP and defense. All four replacements were logged.

targeting.source: GOB 1070 is a self modifier with stacking type 37 and ballistic accuracy 4, max HP 70, ballistic damage 2, ballistic defense 4.
targeting.runtime: AbilitySupport selects the caster; AbilityBuffs applies and replaces the class modifiers. AbilityStats and the max-health update consume the records.
targeting.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.SelfUpgradesApplyTheirOwnCombatStatsAndRemoveWithTheNextUpgrade checks target, all live totals and removal. gunman-upgrades-and-evasive sends live selected-NPC casts and checks ordered old/new accuracy records.

stats.source: GOB 242 stores +20 melee, ballistic and thrown defense for 12 seconds in the three WhenEnabled 1 modifiers.
stats.runtime: CombatSpecials.Landed applies the three modifiers to the caster while preserving the ordinary hit. Typed round consumers use those values and TimedEffects schedules cleanup.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.PistolEvasiveKeepsTheHitAndAppliesThreeDefensesOnlyToItsCaster and gunman-upgrades-and-evasive verify target damage, caster-only modifiers and all three expiry records.
